description: This file defines the ManagedFile class, a Drupal form element for AJAX-enabled file uploads with validation, processing, and removal functionalities.

classes.name: ManagedFile
classes.description: A Drupal form element class providing an AJAX-enabled file upload widget with validation and management features.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns the element's default properties and settings.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes input values, handles file uploads, and manages default values.

methods.name: uploadAjaxCallback
methods.description: Handles AJAX responses for file upload interactions, updating the form dynamically.

methods.name: processManagedFile
methods.description: Expands the managed_file element to include upload and remove controls, and manages associated behaviors.

methods.name: preRenderManagedFile
methods.description: Adjusts element access permissions based on current file state before rendering.

methods.name: validateManagedFile
methods.description: Validates the managed_file element, ensuring files exist and are accessible.

methods.name: fileUsage
methods.description: Returns the file usage service for managing file references.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission for upload and remove actions, updating file references accordingly.
